description: This file contains an abstract test class 'ValueTypeFieldCodecTester' used for testing serialization and deserialization of value types with codecs in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes test methods for round-trip serialization checks, utilizing Xunit for unit testing.

classes.name: ValueTypeFieldCodecTester
classes.description: An abstract generic test class for verifying the serialization logic of value types using specific codecs within the Orleans serialization infrastructure. It provides test methods to verify round-trip serialization and deserialization correctness.

methods.name: ValueSerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests that values of type TField can be serialized and then deserialized to produce the original value, ensuring serializer correctness.

methods.name: DirectAccessValueSerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Performs round-trip serialization tests directly using the value serializer, verifying that the process preserves the data integrity.

methods.name: TestRoundTrippedValueViaValueSerializer
methods.description: Helper method that serializes a value to a pipe and then deserializes it, asserting the deserialized value matches the original.
